title: Broadcast
description: [PROPOSED] The optional message a harness submits in the broadcast window (AGENTS.md §7 step 2, §10). "none" means no message and carries no text; "all" or a class must carry non-empty text. The GM announces the text word for word. An invalid broadcast is dropped, as if no message had been sent. Self-contained so it can be turned into a generation grammar directly. The spec's [None], [all] and [class] map to "none", "all" and a class id.

oneOf.title: Message to everyone or to one class

to.description: "all", or the class of the single recipient.

text.description: [DECIDED] Same limits as action text: the engine (not the GM) cuts longer text off at the 2000th character, then after the 150th word, with no penalty (AGENTS.md §10, §11). This schema describes the message after those cuts.
